lessonTurns.zh: 这样我还能做点有氧，说实话腿部的泵感总是

lessonTurns.text: nice. For years now I've been doing my split as follows.
lessonTurns.zh: 很爽。这些年来我一直按这样的分化来练。

lessonTurns.text: I'll do chest and tris together, back and bise together,
lessonTurns.zh: 我会把胸和三头一起练，背和二头一起练，

lessonTurns.text: and then arms and shoulders coupled together. And of course, can't skip leg day.
lessonTurns.zh: 然后手臂和肩膀搭配在一起。当然，不能跳过练腿日。

lessonTurns.text: Funny enough though, I didn't do any of those today.
lessonTurns.zh: 不过有意思的是，今天这些我都没做。

lessonTurns.text: I just hit a random upper body workout because I've been so sore from my
lessonTurns.zh: 我就随便练了个上半身，因为我之前的训练

lessonTurns.text: previous workouts. So something's better than nothing.
lessonTurns.zh: 让我太酸痛了。所以聊胜于无吧。
